name: Minimum
description: Modern optimization mod for Geometry Dash. Faster processing, less lag on dense levels, better FPS while recording or Discord share screen. Sequel to Algebra Dash.

performance-mode.name: Performance Mode
performance-mode.description: Master switch. Turns on the strongest optimizations. Best for recording, streaming and Discord share screen.

skip-static-batch.name: Skip Empty Batches
skip-static-batch.description: Skips draw calls for sprite batches with no quads. Less GPU work on busy levels.

cull-particles.name: Cull Offscreen Particles
cull-particles.description: Stops updating particle systems far off screen. Cuts lag spikes from particle spam.

limit-particles.name: Limit Particle Count
limit-particles.description: Caps how many particles a system can emit. Big help on levels that spam particles. Slightly less visual effects.

particle-cap.name: Particle Cap
particle-cap.description: Max particles per system when Limit Particle Count is on. Lower = more FPS, fewer effects.

skip-particle-draw.name: Skip Offscreen Particle Draw
skip-particle-draw.description: Does not draw particle systems that are off screen. Saves GPU when recording or sharing screen.

fast-alt-tab.name: Fast Alt Tab
fast-alt-tab.description: Skips saving when the game loses focus so alt tabbing feels instant.

force-rgba8888.name: Force RGBA8888
force-rgba8888.description: Forces textures to load as RGBA8888 for sharper visuals. Windows only. Needs texture reload.

anti-aliasing.name: Anti Aliasing
anti-aliasing.description: MSAA level from 0 off to 4 for x16. Windows only. Needs restart. Can cost FPS while recording.
